header:
# Town of Berkshire municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists the Selectboard as Jason Kittell (Chair), Andrew Smith (Vice Chair), Todd Kinney, Tony Archambault, and Mark Larivee. The Secretary of State's Selectboard Members directory publishes no Berkshire roster ('Contact the Town Clerk').
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists 'Town Clerk/Treasurer: Emily Fecteau' (Berkshire combines the offices).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Emily Fecteau as Town Clerk of Berkshire and as Town Treasurer of Berkshire.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists 'Town Clerk/Treasurer: Emily Fecteau' (Berkshire combines the offices).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Emily Fecteau as Town Clerk of Berkshire and as Town Treasurer of Berkshire.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists the Moderator office as 'Vacant', so no holder is recorded.

Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: names one lister, Hilegard Jamka (the page also lists an appointed assessor, Justin Mason). The other two lister seats are named in no official source, so only Jamka is recorded.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists the Auditors as Hilegard Jamka, Breanna Thompson, and Linda Sweetser.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists 'Delinquent Tax Collector: Virginia Messier'. Berkshire fills the office separately from the treasurer (17 V.S.A. section 2651d).
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists Rony Archambault as Road Commissioner among the town officers (a distinct person from Selectboard member Tony Archambault).
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a first constable at annual town meeting.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists no constable, and no other official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists no grand juror, and no other official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent to prosecute and defend suits at annual town meeting.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists no town agent, and no other official source publishes the holder, so none is recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists six Berkshire justices of the peace: Jerod Adams, Trish Adams, Meghan Corrigan, Stacy Gregoire, Marilyn "Lyn" Lauffer, and Ryan Roy.
Town of Berkshire official website, 'Town Officers' page: lists the same six justices of the peace.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists six Berkshire justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term (Jerod Adams, Trish Adams, Meghan Corrigan, Stacy Gregoire, Marilyn "Lyn" Lauffer, Ryan Roy); they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
